subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should this PR land as the narrow bootstrap-context stall fix despite the glob-walker and bootstrap-hook interleaving compatibility risks?
rationale: The code keeps the plugin SDK surface stable and has focused proof, but automation cannot decide whether existing installs may observe acceptable changes in extra-bootstrap glob ordering/parity or hook-chain interleaving.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Land the refreshed PR as the narrow fix and explicitly accept the runtime compatibility/session-state tradeoff.

options.title: Request stronger live proof
options.body: Ask for a full embedded_run channel proof before merge if maintainer confidence requires end-to-end message-delivery evidence.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Keep the async file/glob work but remove or separately gate hook interleaving if that behavior change is too risky.

recommendation.title: Approve after refresh
recommendation.body: Land the refreshed PR as the narrow fix and explicitly accept the runtime compatibility/session-state tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans hook contracts, bootstrap context, and plugin SDK boundary policy where their recent history is strongest.
